SPEAKER FORMS: &nbspFor record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.

1.
CALL TO ORDER.
Mayor Hofbauer called the meeting to order at 7:00 p.m.
2.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
3.
ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM BISHOP, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND LOA
PRESENT:
Steven D. Hofbauer, Laura Bettencourt, Juan Carrillo, Richard J. Loa.
ABSENT:
Austin Bishop.
Motion: excuse the absence of Mayor Pro Tem Bishop.
Moved by Laura Bettencourt,
seconded by Richard J. Loa.
Vote: Motion carried (4-0)
Yes: Steven D. Hofbauer, Laura Bettencourt, Juan Carrillo, Richard J. Loa.
Absent: Austin Bishop.
4.
PRESENTATION:
4.1
Public Arts Master Plan Workshop. (Staff Reference: Director of Recreation and Culture Smith)
Director of Recreation and Culture Smith presented a staff report and PowerPoint presentation regarding the Public Art Master Plan.
Gail Goldman of Goldman & Associates and Lesley Elwood of Elwood & Associates spoke regarding the Public Arts Master Plan.
Councilmember Bettencourt asked when art ages does it go somewhere and Ms. Elwood responded.
Councilmember Loa spoke about possible revenue sources and about developers and businesses being major participants.
Councilmember Carrillo stated he would like a policy added to create a community acceptance process.
Mayor Hofbauer asked questions about historical art vs. new art. Consultants Goldman & Elwood responded that the Public Art Master Plan is about new art and living artists.
Public Comments: George Sencon spoke about art vs. artifacts; Bob Altos spoke about the City's historical art; Carla Corona, Professor of Theater Arts at Antelope Valley College, spoke; Jason Zink spoke regarding preserving history and wanting the history of aerospace to be in city art; Kris Holiday, high school teacher, spoke in support of youth art; Destiny spoke in favor of art for youth; Matthew Madrid spoke about adding information about the artists; Lucia, playwright, spoke in favor; Marco Aguilar, professional artist and teacher, spoke in favor of community art; Haley Crow, Assistant Director of Antelope Valley Art spoke about art possibilities; Anna Livingston spoke in favor; Nathaniel Anjetta spoke regarding artwork near poppies; Renato DeGarcia spoke in favor.
City Manager Purtee spoke about the artisan community and will reach out to community businesses and developers.
Mayor Hofbauer read a letter from citizen Shannon Bundt into the record regarding her support on making the Master Art Plan and art available to the public.
5.

Public Comments: None.
6.

Public Comments: None.

8.
CLOSED SESSION.
Closed session was held from 8:57 p.m. - 9:20 p.m.
9.
ANNOUNCEMENT BY CITY ATTORNEY of item(s) discussed in Closed Session.
Item 7.1 CC – California Teamsters Local 911 Public, Professional & Medical Employees Union / Conference with Labor Negotiators – In closed session the City Negotiators updated the City Council on upcoming negotiating items with Teamsters Local 911 and received unanimous direction thereon. No further reportable action at this time.
10.
ADJOURNMENT.
Mayor Hofbauer adjourned the meeting at 9:25 p.m.
PASSED, APPROVED, and ADOPTED this 4th day of June 2019.
